usage.callShape: POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} with JSON body {text}. voice_id is a REQUIRED path segment (use a real ElevenLabs voice id, e.g. 21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM for the default Rachel voice).
usage.outputShape: Raw response body is binary audio (Content-Type: audio/mpeg, MP3). Not JSON — save the bytes directly to a .mp3 file.
quirks: The registry-listed URL/method are WRONG: it shows GET https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} but the real call is POST and {voice_id} must be a concrete value.
The base path WITHOUT a voice_id (https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech) returns 404 for both GET and POST — you MUST append a real voice_id path segment.
Use a real ElevenLabs voice id in the path. 21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM (Rachel) is a known-good default and was used for this verified call.
Response is binary MP3 audio, NOT JSON. Write the raw body to disk as .mp3.

body.text is the only required field; optional: model_id, language_code, voice_settings, seed, previous_text, next_text, apply_text_normalization. Optional query params: output_format, enable_logging.
Price is per-call ~$0.08 USDC on Base (maxAmountRequired 80000), billed against api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}.
usage.guide: Call POST https://x402.orth.sh/elevenlabs/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} where {voice_id} is a real ElevenLabs voice id (e.g. 21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM for the default Rachel voice) — the base path without a voice_id 404s. Send a JSON body {"text":"...your text..."}; optionally add model_id, voice_settings, or an output_format query param. Pay the x402 quote (~$0.08 USDC on Base). The response body is raw MP3 audio (Content-Type audio/mpeg), so write the bytes straight to a .mp3 file — do not parse it as JSON.
